tools.name: grade_tools
tools.description: Grade MCP tool definitions (the tools array from a tools/list result) for how well AI agents can pick and call them. Returns a 0–100 score and A–F grade, per-tool scores, and findings with concrete fixes: missing or weak descriptions, untyped parameters, strings without maxLength, missing required o

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: grade_tools · Private data: grade_tools · Public sink: grade_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: grade_tools · Private data: grade_tools · Public sink: grade_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
